###1.load the data
```{r}
##load data using a function for all 12obj, create seurat_obj,merge to one and save it without any process
#folder
data.dir="../../tomas.gomes/processed.data/autoimm_scrna_TomasGuerreiro/Datasets/Systemic Sclerosis/GSE138669_RAW/"
# List all .h5 files
h5.files=list.files( path = data.dir,pattern = "_feature_bc_matrix\\.h5$",full.names = TRUE)

# Assign sample names SS1–SS12
sample.names=paste0("SS", seq_along(h5.files))

 # Loop: read, filter, create Seurat object, save
for (i in seq_along(h5.files)) {
  message("Processing ", sample.names[i])
 # Read raw counts
  SS.x=Read10X_h5(h5.files[i], use.names = TRUE, unique.features = TRUE) 
# defaultDrops
  iscell_dd <- defaultDrops(SS.x, expected = 5000)
 # emptyDrops
  eout=emptyDrops(SS.x, lower = 200)
  eout$FDR[is.na(eout$FDR)] <- 1
  iscell_ed=eout$FDR <= 0.01
  # metadata
  meta=data.frame(
    iscell_dd = iscell_dd,
    iscell_ed = iscell_ed,
    row.names = colnames(SS.x)
  )
  # keep cells
  keep=iscell_dd | iscell_ed
  # Create Seurat object
  SS=CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = SS.x[, keep],
    meta.data = meta[keep, ]
  )
  # Add sample name inside Seurat object
  SS$sample=sample.names[i]   
  
# Save Seurat object
  saveRDS(
    SS,
    file = paste0("data/process/SeuratObjects/Systemic_Sclerosis_in_Skin/", sample.names[i], ".rds")
  )
}

##merge in one seurat obj
# Folder with Seurat objects
seurat.dir="data/process/SeuratObjects/Systemic_Sclerosis_in_Skin/"
rds.files=list.files(seurat.dir,pattern = "^SS[0-9]+\\.rds$",full.names = TRUE)
# Read them into a list
SS_list=lapply(rds.files, readRDS)
# Name the list (SS1–SS12)
names(SS_list)=sub("\\.rds$", "", basename(rds.files))

# Merge
SS=merge(
  x = SS_list[[1]],
  y = SS_list[-1],
  add.cell.ids = names(SS_list),
  project = "Systemic_Sclerosis"
)
saveRDS(SS,file = "data/process/SeuratObjects/Systemic_Sclerosis_in_Skin/SS_raw.rds")

#look for the assay if no RNA seet it as RNA
SS=readRDS("data/process/SeuratObjects/SS/SS_raw.rds")
DefaultAssay(SS_obj)

#save memory
rm(eout,meta,SS,SS_list,SS.x,h5.files,i,iscell_ed,iscell_dd,keep,rds.files,sample.names)
gc(full = TRUE)
getwd()
```

SS[["percent.mt"]]=PercentageFeatureSet(SS,pattern = "^MT-")
VlnPlot(SS,features = c("nCount_RNA","nFeature_RNA","percent.mt"), ncol = 3,log = TRUE)

###3-statistics
```{r}
##norm, fvf,scale,runpca
SS=NormalizeData(SS)
SS=FindVariableFeatures(SS)
SS=ScaleData(SS,vars.to.regress = c("nCount_RNA","percent.mt"),features = VariableFeatures(object = SS))
SS=RunPCA(SS, features = VariableFeatures(object = SS))
ElbowPlot(SS, ndims = 50, reduction = "pca")
SS=RunUMAP(SS, dims = 1:30)
DimPlot(SS,reduction = "umap", label = TRUE)

```


###4-integration
```{r}
##integration
library(harmony)
SS =RunHarmony(SS,group.by.vars = "sample",orig.reduction = "pca",dims.use = 1:30  )
SS[["RNA"]]=JoinLayers(SS[["RNA"]])
SS = RunUMAP(SS, reduction = "harmony", dims= 1:30, reduction.name = "umap.harmony")
SS=FindNeighbors(SS,reduction= "harmony",dims = 1:30)


#for the resolution

for (res in seq(0.2, 1, by = 0.1)) {
  SS=FindClusters(SS, resolution = res)
  colname=paste0("res_", res)
  SS[[colname]]=SS$seurat_clusters
}
res_cols=grep("^res_", colnames(SS@meta.data), value = TRUE)
for (res in res_cols) {
  p=DimPlot(SS, group.by = res, label = TRUE, reduction = "umap.harmony") +
       ggtitle(paste("Resolution:", res))
  print(p)
  readline(prompt="Press [Enter] to see the next resolution...")
}

#save all
pdf("output/SS/All_resolutions_UMAP.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
for (res in res_cols) {
  p <- DimPlot(SS, group.by = res, label = TRUE, reduction = "umap.harmony") +
       ggtitle(paste("Resolution:", res))
  print(p)
}
dev.off()


#save 
p=DimPlot(SS,group.by = "res_0.8",label = TRUE,reduction = "umap.harmony" )+ ggtitle("Resolution: 0.8") +NoLegend()
ggsave(filename = "output/SS/SS_resolution.png",plot = p,width = 12,height = 8,dpi = 300)



```


###5-clusters and markers
```{r}
###clusters

SS=FindNeighbors(SS,reduction= "harmony",dims = 1:30)
SS=FindClusters(SS_obj, resolution = 0.8,cluster.name = "harmony_clusters")
#markers
SS_markers=FindAllMarkers(SS,only.pos = TRUE,min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)
SS_markers=SS_markers %>% filter(p_val_adj < 0.05, abs(avg_log2FC) > 0.25)



```

###7Correlation
```{r}
##correlation with the cells
# 1️⃣ Set identities to cell types
Idents(SS) <- "Major_Celltype"

# sanity check
levels(Idents(SS))
# should show cell type names, NOT numbers

# 2️⃣ Average expression per cell type
av.expSS <- AverageExpression(
  SS,
  assays = "RNA",
  slot = "data"
)$RNA
# rows = genes, columns = cell types

# 3️⃣ Cell-type correlation matrix
correlation_matrixSS <- cor(
  as.matrix(av.expSS),
  use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
)

# safety cleanup
correlation_matrixSS[is.na(correlation_matrixSS)]=0

# 4️⃣ Save heatmap
png(
  filename = "output/SS/SS_correlation.png",
  width = 3000,
  height = 2400,
  res = 300
)

pheatmap(
  correlation_matrixSS,
  clustering_method = "ward.D2",
  fontsize_row = 9,
  fontsize_col = 9
)

dev.off()

```
